Hi Tim —

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. Per our compliance checklist we need to validate two things before the Private Control Plane (customer-managed control plane in your VPC) goes live:

1) SAML assertion attributes and binding behavior for initial sign-in and admin session creation.
2) SCIM group sync and membership accuracy for the delegated admin roles we agreed on.

I've attached the IdP metadata export and the SCIM schema dump we requested from your team. Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the SAML Subject NameID format (email vs persistent) your IdP will emit? We need stable identifiers for audit mapping.
- Please provision two test users and a test group named "rdw-priv-admins" with the attributes listed in the attached scim-schema-v1.json.

Proposed acceptance criteria (short):
- Successful SAML authn flow with NameID mapped to user.email (or clear alternative).
- SCIM: group membership matches within 2 minutes of change in IdP -> Redwood SCIM endpoint.
- Role mapping validated: membership in rdw-priv-admins => Redwood role: private_control_plane.admin

Attachments referenced: [Attachment: idp-metadata.xml (XML)] [Attachment: scim-schema-v1.json (JSON)]

I'll pull Marcus and Aditya into the thread for the role-binding confirmation and for any runtime constraints to watch for.

Thanks,

— Laura Bennett

Laura / team —

Short answers:
- Mapping: we can accept email NameID as the primary identifier if we apply a normalization step: lowercase the value and strip known alias suffixes (e.g., +tagging). That gives us near-immutable behavior for audit while allowing Acme to keep email-based logins. For customers who need persistent, we support assertion of an external_id attribute; we'll accept whichever is present and use it as the canonical id for sessions and audit.

- SCIM sync window: Our staging SCIM consumer processed Acme's sample delta in 1.3s locally. In multi-tenant smoke tests we saw up to ~75s under extreme churn, but that's with very aggressive change rates and without prefix caching. For a single-customer Private CP we expect <5s typical, 95th percentile <20s. We will enable prefix caching and rate-limiting to guarantee the 2-min SLA.

Attached is the role-mappings.csv with the proposed mappings. Highlights:
- rdw-priv-admins -> private_control_plane.admin (full cluster admin incl. role grants)
- rdw-priv-ops -> private_control_plane.ops (deploy/read telemetry, no admin grants)
- rdw-priv-audit -> private_control_plane.readonly (read-only, audit logs only)

Attachments: [Attachment: role-mappings.csv (CSV)]

Notes for rollout:
- We'll require one verification run: create a group change in Acme IdP, confirm SCIM delta to our staging, then verify role binding applied in the private control plane.
- We'll collect SAML assertion samples (encoded) and validate signature + assertion lifetime constraints.

Happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through the CSV.

— Aditya
Principal Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
